title: Public /kpis: one 'cost per finished task' figure, caveats in the fold
description:
Repository: JKershaw/LinearViewer (Harbour). One PR. Runs after LIN-3710 (same files).

## Why

On 20 Oct the operator recommended: label the figure "Cost per finished task" (API-equivalent, last 30 days); move the coverage and bias shares into a "Show the numbers" fold under it, still published but not beside it; keep the cash figure out. John, 20 Oct: "I agree with your recommendation." He agreed to the operator's recommendation; those words are the operator's, not his.

This supersedes the 2026-08-03 ruling on two points only: the label ("cost per terminal-marked task") and the placement (shares "beside the number"). The rest stands, including that "verified" and its synonyms never appear in the builder's name, exports or field names.

## What is true now (origin/main 8f39afd8)

* LIN-3703 (a9f81290, #1995) dropped the card (docs/plans/kpis-public-design.md:25). The builder stayed: `computeTerminalMarkedTaskCost` (lib/terminal-marked-task-cost.js:211), called at lib/kpi-stats.js:977. The file has no urlKey, workspace or account field, so it emits instance-wide aggregates only.
* Old card: `git show a9f81290~1:lib/render-kpis.js` :114-298. Figure = `pricedTicketCostUsd / pricedTicketCount` (:238-240), not `costUsd`. `formatUsd` (:33) gives "—" on null; `formatShare` (:45-50) gives "—" on null and "<1%" for a nonzero share that rounds to 0. Wording rules (:161-176): `inFlightUsd` is "unresolved", never "in-flight"; `overheadUsd` is "resolved overhead", never "overhead"; `pricedLineageShare` is never "capture coverage".
* Records of the 2026-08-03 ruling: lib/terminal-marked-task-cost.js:6, :12-13, :635-636; in history only, a9f81290\~1:lib/render-kpis.js:154-159 and the label pins a9f81290\~1:tests/unit/render-kpis.test.js:457, :709 and tests/e2e/kpis.spec.js:48. Other mentions of the card: [kpis-public-design.md:117](<http://kpis-public-design.md:117>), :153; [source-map.md:112](<http://source-map.md:112>); [configuration.md:37](<http://configuration.md:37>); .env.example:128. docs/archive/5.html:148 and 6.html:443 are dated documents using the old label: leave.
* The cached public view `toPublicKpis` (lib/kpi-stats.js:1130-1157) is embedded whole as `__KPI_DATA__` (lib/render-kpis.js:191). `PUBLIC_LEAF_REGISTRY` (:1043-1056) must list every numeric leaf (kpi-public-floor.test.js:177). Three tests pin the six top-level keys: render-kpis.test.js:59, kpi-public-floor.test.js:239, tests/e2e/kpis.spec.js:80.

## Done when

1. In "Does the work land?", under the rate headline: value "$X.XX", label "Cost per finished task", sub-line "API-equivalent · last 30 days", one caption: "A task counts as finished when its agent marked it done." The value is "—", never $0, when `pricedTicketCostUsd` is null or `pricedTicketCount` is 0.
2. A closed `<details>` "Show the numbers" under it holds the tasks averaged (`pricedTicketCount`) and seven shares, each with a plain label naming its base. Coverage, of all runs: `attributableLineageShare`, `captureRateShare`, `pricedLineageShare` (of runs that reported usage). Bias, of finished tasks: `closeOutLineageShare`, `evidenceLinkedShare`, `opencodeSummedShare` (known runner only), `unknownHarnessShare`. Format as old `formatShare`. Shares appear nowhere outside the fold.
3. Not shown, not in the view: cash, `unknownLaneUsd`, `inFlightUsd`, `overheadUsd`, marker occupancy, `ticketsPerPricedLane`, `issueCount`, `unpriced`, `laneLandedCount`. A reader can use none, and the dollar lines would publish total spend. If shown later, the wording rules above apply.
4. `toPublicKpis` adds `cost: { windowDays, perTaskUsd, tasks, shares }`. It divides (2dp, null if nothing priced) and picks named fields; it never spreads `stats.terminalMarkedTaskCost`, which stays out of the view and HTML.
5. Every `cost.*` leaf is in `PUBLIC_LEAF_REGISTRY` as `open`, why: "average or ratio over dispatch lineages or tasks across every workspace; not a count of people". Small-sample rule: when `tasks` is below `PUBLIC_COUNT_FLOOR` (5), the view publishes `cost: null` and the page shows "—", so an average never stands for one or two tasks. A test pins `tasks` = 4 to null and 5 to a figure.

## Tests

Each new test fails first.

* kpi-public-floor.test.js: `cost` in the key list; registry walk; `cost` holds only the picked keys even if stats carry `cashUsd`, `inFlightUsd`, `issueCount`; null when nothing priced; division uses `pricedTicketCostUsd`.
* render-kpis.test.js: label and sub-line; "—" and no "$0" on null; the `<details>` holds all seven values and labels, and none appear with it cut out; "<1%"; "terminal-marked" and "cash:" absent.
* tests/helpers/public-kpis-fixture.js:73 gets the builder fields; `SELECTORS.publicKpis` (tests/helpers.js:111) gains `kpis-cost`, `kpis-cost-value`, `kpis-cost-numbers`.
* tests/e2e/kpis.spec.js: key list; figure visible; fold opens on click; no overflow at 390px.
* terminal-marked-task-cost.test.js passes unedited.

## Docs

* kpis-public-design.md: row :25 becomes "changed"; add the `cost` leaves to the registry table (:60-72) and ids to :90; add a short section with the quote, the operator's recommendation, the two superseded points and what stands; fix :117 and :133.
* Comment-only edits at the builder lines above: label and placement superseded 20 Oct; naming rule stands. Reword [source-map.md:108/:110/:112](<http://source-map.md:108/:110/:112>), [configuration.md:37](<http://configuration.md:37>), .env.example:128: the API-equivalent figure is public, cash never.
* Leave docs/archive and docs/reviews. No new line in CLAUDE.md.

## Out of scope

Weekly cost trend; the cash figure; the workspace page; the builder's maths.

## Order and open questions

Runs after "Public /kpis: trend charts and a shared chart helper" (same files); do not wait. At the start, if origin/main has `public/chart-helpers.js` and its "Show the numbers" disclosure, reuse it; else plain `<details>` (neither exists at 8f39afd8).

1. The privacy line (render-kpis.js:184) and /privacy (render-legal.js:132, pinned render-legal.test.js:194) say "totals and counts only"; a dollar average and percentages go slightly past it. Default: leave both; note in the PR.
2. The ruling was first recorded outside the repo (LIN-1958); the operator marks it superseded there before this runs.

## Operator notes

**Rules for this run**

* No live calls to outside services (GitHub, Linear, OpenRouter, [harbour.cat](<http://harbour.cat>) or any other live host). Tests use the existing fakes.
* No paid model or OpenRouter calls.
* This is one PR. Don't split it into child tickets.
* No parallel forks or background sub-agents; one part at a time.
* Targeted tests while iterating (`node --test tests/unit/<file>.test.js`). Full unit suite (`npm run test:unit`) once before opening the PR. Leave e2e to CI.
* A failing-then-passing test is the witness for any behaviour change.
* Keep every existing ticket reference and every reason comment beside the code it governs; drop one only if its code is gone, and list those in the PR.
* A new production file (anything outside `tests/` and `docs/`) gets a pattern in `scripts/code-shape/areas.json` for the area that owns it, in the same PR. First match wins there, so check the file lands in that area and not in "Other features": run `node scripts/code-shape/seams.mjs . <commit>` at the base commit and at your final commit, report the area-pair count both times, and give the reason for any new pair. If it cannot run in your checkout (exit 2, `acorn` missing), record it as not run.
* Prompt text (templates, meta-prompt, runner prompt) is size-frozen (`tests/unit/prompt-size-budget.test.js`). If you add prompt text, remove bytes elsewhere or raise the ceiling with the reason recorded beside it (LIN-3633), and say which in the PR.
* Where a choice is still open, keep today's behaviour, write it up as an open question in the PR, and carry on. Never stop to wait for a person. A check that needs a live service or a person is recorded in the PR as not run (what, why, follow-up), not a reason to hold the close.

## Implemented (close-out)

Implemented as specified in [https://github.com/JKershaw/LinearViewer/pull/2006](<https://github.com/JKershaw/LinearViewer/pull/2006>) (squash-merge 71a42131c91d63ac393d1e29690f59c082963a74), plus two review fixes (a bare-share-value assertion and a source-map typo). No plan, research or scoping-design sections were embedded in this description, so nothing was pruned: the problem statement, Done-when list, tests, docs and operator rules above are kept as written. The full pre-close-out description is in the task snapshots (captured 2026-10-20T11:46:46Z) and the history is in the comment trail.

comments.body:
PR: https://github.com/JKershaw/LinearViewer/pull/2006 (commit a51b79e9). CI green (ci-success; unit, 4 e2e shards, secret scan).

Done: public /kpis shows "Cost per finished task" ($X.XX, or — never $0) with the API-equivalent sub-line and caption; the tasks averaged and the seven shares sit in a closed "Show the numbers" fold, labelled by base. toPublicKpis adds cost {windowDays, perTaskUsd, tasks, shares}, picked by name, null when tasks < 5; all cost.* leaves registered open. Cash and other dollar/count lines are not in the view.

Witness: with the lib changes stashed, the new tests failed (14); with them, all pass. npm run test:unit 18808/0. seams.mjs: 66 area links at base and final; no new production file.

Open questions (kept current behaviour, written up in the PR): the privacy line "totals and counts only" is left as is; superseding the LIN-1958 ruling outside the repo is the operator's step.

## Review — LIN-3714

Reviewed PR https://github.com/JKershaw/LinearViewer/pull/2006, head `a51b79e9` (base `39cd7624`, after LIN-3710).

CI: green on head a51b79e9 (Unit tests, E2E shards 1–4, Secret scan, CI success). I also ran it myself: `npm run test:unit` gave 18808/0 at head and 18794/0 at base, with no failures on either branch, so there are no failure names to diff. Head has +14 tests.

**Scope vs plan:** the diff matches the ticket's surfaces: `lib/kpi-stats.js`, `lib/render-kpis.js`, comment-only edits to `lib/terminal-marked-task-cost.js`, `public/kpis.css`, the fixture, `SELECTORS`, unit and e2e tests, and the named docs (no archive/reviews, no CLAUDE.md). There is no new production file, so `areas.json` needs no entry. No prompt text changed. `terminal-marked-task-cost.test.js` is unedited.

**Requirements checked against the code:**
- Done-when 1: the card sits after `headline(outcomes)` and before the outcome-trend chart. It has the label, sub-line and one caption. The value is `—` when `pricedTicketCostUsd` is null, when `tasks` is 0, or when `tasks` < 5. `$0` appears in none of those cases.
- Done-when 2: a closed `<details>` titled "Show the numbers" holds the task count and all seven shares. I checked the labels against the builder's denominators: `captureRateShare` and `attributableLineageShare` are over `ranLineages`, `pricedLineageShare` is over `usageBearingLineages`, and the bias shares are over T. `formatShare` matches the old a9f81290~1 one (`—`, `0%`, `<1%`).
- Done-when 3/4: `publicCost` picks named fields and divides `pricedTicketCostUsd` (not `costUsd`). No spread.
- Done-when 5: there are 10 `cost.*` registry leaves, all `open`, with the required why. tasks = 4 gives null and 5 gives a figure.
- Docs: kpis-public-design.md rows :25, :72 and :95, the new section, and :122/:150 are done. source-map, configuration.md, .env.example and the builder comments are done, and the naming rule is kept.

**Regression check:** the last commits on these files are LIN-3710 (#2003, the base) and LIN-3703 (#1995). This PR keeps both intact: the chart disclosures are unchanged and the `__KPI_DATA__` view-only embed still holds. It does not re-apply anything reverted. Nothing touched these paths on main after the ticket was created. Main has since moved to `7ea6d82a` (LIN-3718, #2005), which shares no files with this PR, and the PR is MERGEABLE.

**Mutation checks** (on `kpi-public-floor` and `render-kpis`; all reverted):
- floor changed to `< 1`: 2 red
- divisor changed to `costUsd`: 6 red
- `terminalMarkedTaskCost` spread into `cost`: 3 red
- null replaced with a computed value: 2 red
- cost registry leaves dropped: 2 red
- `<details open>`: 1 red
- `<1%` branch removed: 1 red
- card moved above the headline: 1 red
- **Bare share values drawn beside the figure, outside the fold, without labels or `data-share`: 0 red.** The "only inside the fold" tests check `label: value` pairs and `data-share`, never the bare values. The ticket's test line asks for "none [of the values and labels] appear with it cut out". The fixture's seven values (60/40/80/90/50/25/10%) don't collide with any other page text, so the fix is one line (below). I ran it: green at head, red under this mutation.

**Isolated, or one of a class?** I searched `lib routes public docs/architecture .env.example` for the old label and for `terminalMarkedTaskCost` readers. The only public reader is `toPublicKpis`. The workspace page is out of scope by the ticket. This change is isolated.

**Other checks:**
- Seams: `seams.mjs . <commit>` gives 62 links at both 39cd7624 and a51b79e9, so no new pair. The PR says 66; that's probably a different counter, and both ends still match.
- Rulings: none recorded for LIN-3714.
- Security: every interpolated value goes through `escapeHtml`, and only picked numbers get embedded.
- Shares do appear in `__KPI_DATA__.cost.shares`. That's by design: Done-when 4 publishes them in the view, which is embedded whole. "Nowhere outside the fold" means the drawn page.

**Fixes for close-out to make before merge:**
1. `tests/unit/render-kpis.test.js`, in test `'the shares appear only inside the fold'`, directly after the line `for (const [, [label, value]] of Object.entries(SHARES)) assert.ok(!outside.includes(\`${label}: ${value}\`), label);` add:
   `    for (const [, [, value]] of Object.entries(SHARES)) assert.ok(!outside.includes(value), value);`
2. `docs/architecture/source-map.md:108`: replace `LIN-3710 LIN-3714 adds the "Cost per finished task" figure` with `LIN-3714 adds the "Cost per finished task" figure`. The leading "LIN-3710" is a stray duplicate.

### What CI Did Not Prove
- **Inside** (Done-when 2, "shares appear nowhere outside the fold"). No test pinned bare share values outside the `<details>`, so CI would stay green if they leaked (see mutation 9). **Before the merge:** close-out applies fix 1. The check that tells right from wrong: with fix 1 applied, `node --test tests/unit/render-kpis.test.js` passes at head, and fails once a bare `formatShare` list is added to `costCard`'s body outside `fold`.
- **Inside** (Done-when 1/4, the figure on real data). CI only drives the fixture. Whether production's `pricedTicketCount` reaches 5 (figure shown) or not (`—`, no fold) can only be seen live. **After the deploy:** load `/kpis` and read `window.__KPI_DATA__.cost`. Either it's `null` and the value reads `—` with no fold, or `perTaskUsd === round2(pricedTicketCostUsd / pricedTicketCount)` from the operator's stats, `tasks >= 5`, and the fold lists 7 shares. Neither `cashUsd` nor `inFlightUsd` should appear in the page source. **Rollback:** revert the squash-merge commit of #2006. It's reversible: the view lives only in the 60s in-memory cache, with no migration or persisted shape.
- **Inside**, run substitute limits: my own re-run used the shared local `node_modules` (not a clean environment), and it ran on a51b79e9, whose base is one commit behind main (7ea6d82a, no overlapping files). Close-out re-checks CI on the exact commit it merges.

### Verdict
Approve — conditional on close-out discharging the ledger. Every Done-when item is met and CI is green. The one real gap is a test that doesn't pin bare share values outside the fold (one-line fix 1), plus a doc typo (fix 2).

## Close-out — LIN-3714

**Merged:** https://github.com/JKershaw/LinearViewer/pull/2006, squash commit `71a42131c91d63ac393d1e29690f59c082963a74`, merged with `--match-head-commit d954e5eaf0fa2b5ee36f68a0646113284eae5b0c` after a fresh read that every check on that exact head was green (Unit tests, E2E shards 1–4, Secret scan, CI success). The deploy has landed: the live `/kpis` footer reads `71a4213`.

### Changes I made (commit `d954e5ea`, the only change after the approved head `a51b79e9`)
1. Review fix 1 — `tests/unit/render-kpis.test.js`, test "the shares appear only inside the fold": added the line asserting none of the seven formatted share values appear outside the `<details>`. Witness: green at head; red when I temporarily drew a bare `formatShare` list beside the figure outside the fold (reverted).
2. Review fix 2 — `docs/architecture/source-map.md:108`: dropped the stray leading "LIN-3710" before "LIN-3714 adds the "Cost per finished task" figure".
No stale citation or comment was found that needed a further fix.

### Ledger
- **Inside — bare share values outside the fold:** done by fix 1, shown by the green-at-head / red-under-mutation pair above. Targeted tests (`render-kpis`, `kpi-public-floor`) 82/0 locally; CI green on the new head.
- **Inside — the figure on real data (post-deploy):** done on the landed deploy (`71a4213`). Live `window.__KPI_DATA__.cost` = `{windowDays: 30, perTaskUsd: 16.29, tasks: 497, shares: {attributableLineageShare 0.937, captureRateShare 0.921, pricedLineageShare 1, closeOutLineageShare 0.787, evidenceLinkedShare 0.98, opencodeSummedShare 0.274, unknownHarnessShare 0.002}}`. `tasks` ≥ 5, so the figure shows: value `$16.29`, label "Cost per finished task", sub-line "API-equivalent · last 30 days", the one caption, and a closed `<details data-testid="kpis-cost-numbers">` ("Show the numbers"). None of `cashUsd`, `inFlightUsd`, `unknownLaneUsd`, `overheadUsd` or "terminal-marked" appears anywhere in the page source. I did not independently recompute `round2(pricedTicketCostUsd / pricedTicketCount)` from the operator's raw stats (no access to them); that division is pinned by the unit tests (divisor mutation to `costUsd` went red 6 in review).
- **Rollback (named by review):** revert the squash-merge commit `71a42131` of #2006. Reversible: the view lives only in the 60s in-memory cache, no migration or persisted shape.
- **Run-substitute limits (review's note):** CI exists, so the ordinary gate applied; it was re-established on the exact merged head `d954e5ea`. Not proven by CI: a clean environment is covered by the GitHub runners, but the local targeted runs used the shared local `node_modules`.

### Not run
- `node scripts/code-shape/seams.mjs` at the final commit: not re-run in close-out (no new production file was added by my change; review recorded 62 area links at both base and the approved head, and my commit touches only a test and a doc).

### Open questions carried (no change made)
- The privacy line / `/privacy` say "totals and counts only"; a dollar average and percentages go slightly past it. Left unchanged by default, noted in the PR. Not filed as a follow-up: the ticket itself directs "leave both; note in the PR" and review did not mark it outside work.
- Superseding the LIN-1958 ruling outside the repo is the operator's step.

### Housekeeping
- Archive: `brief?noRefresh=1` called; `GET /snapshots` confirms a snapshot (captured 2026-10-20T11:46:46Z) carrying the full pre-close-out description (8077 chars). The description contained no plan/research/scoping-design sections, so nothing was pruned; I appended a short "Implemented (close-out)" stub with the PR link and the note that the plan was implemented as approved.
- Related tickets: siblings LIN-3717, LIN-3722, LIN-3713, LIN-3711 are different work and are not settled by this; none closed. No outside follow-ups to file (review's ledger had no outside items).
- Final CI state: green on `d954e5ea` (all 7 checks SUCCESS); PR state MERGED.
